boundaries: Adaptive-control coefficients are a declared benchmark MDP, not measured process-tensor data.
Virtual edges are abstract heralded qutrit edge tokens; complete cluster/fusion overhead remains open.
The attractor is an ideal orbit-projector reservoir target.
Thermodynamic and substrate results separate exact event counts from unmeasured platform coefficients.
Checksum and heralded-route theorems assume single defects or independent heralded edge events.
The symmetry bath is an ideal permutation Markov process, not a laboratory dissipator.

3829_noise_adaptive_geometry_hypervisor.boundary: Finite fully observed benchmark MDP; not a learned device process tensor or measured logical-error law.

3830_measurement_only_virtual_w33_topolo.boundary: Edge-token/teleportation abstraction. Source, fusion, memory, classical-feedforward, and code overheads are not included.
3830_measurement_only_virtual_w33_topolo.minimum_reason: Each node has degree 12 and can consume at most one edge token per round; the frozen 1-factorization attains 12.

3831_autonomous_association_scheme_attra.boundary: Ideal association-scheme reservoir target. A physical dissipator implementing the orbit projector remains to be engineered.

3832_thermodynamic_geometry_tournament.boundary: Retry-plus-wirelength and Landauer-floor benchmark only; wall-plug source, cooling, detector, and decoder energy are not measured.

3833_substrate_inversion_tournament.boundary: Exact primitive-count inversion, not a vendor benchmark. Mapping a physical platform to coefficients requires measured data.
3833_substrate_inversion_tournament.conclusion: No substrate is coefficient-independently optimal; the preferred implementation changes with fabrication, consumable-entanglement, latency, and routing-energy prices.

3834_bonkers_srg_digital_twin_checksum.boundary: Exact single-edge digital-twin checksum and localizer; simultaneous defects require a separate decoding theorem.
3834_bonkers_srg_digital_twin_checksum.endpoint_localization: The two endpoint rows are uniquely the rows with support 13 (deletion) or 14 (insertion).

3835_bonkers_heralded_topology_distillat.boundary: Independent heralded-edge model; correlated source, memory, and fusion failures are outside the formula.
3835_bonkers_heralded_topology_distillat.path_structure: Four internally disjoint two-hop paths for every nonedge; one direct edge plus two edge-disjoint triangle detours for every edge.

3836_bonkers_transvection_symmetry_bath.boundary: Spectral statement for the ideal discrete symmetry bath; physical jump rates and dissipation costs are not specified.
3836_bonkers_transvection_symmetry_bath.interpretation: Random transvection jumps spread a localized single-site defect over the full point orbit before orbit averaging.
